title: [E-Document] Add AKV switch for PA-related LLM calls
summary: E-Document AI processing now supports switching between LLM models for PA-related calls via Azure Key Vault configuration, preparing for a future model migration.
key_points: Adds an AKV-based switch that selects the model for PA-related E-Document LLM calls
Touches the E-Doc. AI Tool Processor and E-Document MLLM Handler codeunits
Prepares for an upcoming model migration
quote: Adding a mechanism to switch the model being called for PA-related E-Document-owned LLM calls to prepare for the upcoming migration.
